caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular swatch of fabric with a frayed edge on all four sides. The fabric consists of diagonal red lines forming the main background color, intersected by three vertical stripes. Each of these stripes is composed of a blue center flanked by lighter green or yellow edges. The drawing is set inside a lightly outlined rectangular border on a pale, off-white background. The fabric's texture is suggested by the use of linear shading and short strokes, and the overall composition is centered on the page. The words "Home Spun" are written in the lower left outside the border, and "LeRoy McCarrel" is written in the lower right outside the border.
title: Homemade Cloth
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
